summary: Implemented native lifecycle and transport ordering checks; all five literal profile captures, one seeded browser.swap capture, and event/correlation negative controls pass.
limitations: Real-capture tests use GOBI_EFFECTS_QUALIFICATION_INPUT when set, otherwise the local PR23 fixture; they explicitly skip if no fixture is available.
Validation is limited to the five finite capture profile schemas and captured lifecycle semantics; it is not a general Go/browser equivalence claim.
